title: Kin'iro no Chord: Secondo Passo
justification: TVDB 159551 has no season 0; it lists AniDB 6311 and holds the two Secondo Passo episodes as season 2, First Movement (2009-03-26) and Second Movement (2009-06-05), AniDB's two episodes by count, order and date; season 3 is Blue Sky (node 10210). On TMDB 42952 they are season 0 episodes 2 and 3 (2009-03-26, 2009-06-05), after A Summer Encore, so tmdboffset is 1.
